# Independent publication vectors

`go-tlog-v1.json` is generated by `tools/publication-fixtures/main.go` using
`golang.org/x/mod/sumdb/{note,tlog}` v0.42.0, pinned by the module checksums.
It includes 513 leaves, checkpoints around binary and 256-leaf tile boundaries,
inclusion/consistency paths, partial/full C2SP hash tiles, signed conflicting
checkpoints and signed checkpoints from an untrusted key. No private key is
stored in this fixture. The reproducible synthetic seed in the generator is
public test material and must never be used for an operating log.

Regenerate with Go 1.26.10:

```console
cd tools/publication-fixtures
go run -mod=readonly . -output ../../tests/fixtures/publication/go-tlog-v1.json
```

The real writer qualification separately builds Tessera's conformance POSIX
writer at revision `97031af5a3c83a4dddde0675879207eb17c9ec22`, generates fresh
keys, sends synthetic commitments over loopback HTTPS and verifies the
transferred evidence in a kernel network sandbox after deleting the producer
and private keys. It runs through `tools/qualify-publication.py` in CI.
That conformance writer is a test environment, not a production deployment
recommendation. No test submits private project data to a public service.
